title: Plot Holes & Popcorn
desc: Behind-the-scenes secrets, odd casting choices & film world trivia

questions.q: The blood in the elevator scene in 'The Shining' took how many days to set up for a shot lasting just a few seconds?
questions.a: About a year of planning — three days to film, and they used up to 3,000 gallons of fake blood

questions.q: In 'Toy Story', what is the name of the moving company on the truck?
questions.a: Eggman Movers (with the tagline 'Moving? Call Eggman')

questions.q: Which Best Picture winner at the Oscars has the shortest runtime?
The Wilhelm Scream is a famous stock sound effect — in which 1951 film was it first recorded?
questions.a: Distant Drums — though it was named after the character Private Wilhelm in 'The Charge at Feather River' (1953)

questions.q: Which actor has been killed on screen more than any other in Hollywood history?
questions.a: Danny Trejo (by his own estimate, over 80 deaths)

questions.q: In 'The Matrix', everything inside the Matrix has a faint green tint. What colour tint does the real world have?
questions.a: Blue — the colour grading shifts between the two worlds throughout

questions.q: What was the first fully computer-animated feature film ever released?
Alfred Hitchcock made a cameo in nearly all his films. In 'Lifeboat' (1944), which is set entirely on a small boat, how did he appear?
questions.a: In a newspaper ad for a weight-loss product — as the 'before and after' photo

questions.q: The country of Wakanda from 'Black Panther' briefly appeared on a real US government trade partner list. True or false?
questions.a: True — the USDA accidentally listed Wakanda as a free trade partner in 2019

questions.q: Which horror film was marketed with the tagline 'In space, no one can hear you scream'?
